title: haworthia nigra var. pusilla
intro: Haworthia nigra var. pusilla, commonly known as Dwarf Haworthia or Miniature Zebra Plant, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Xanthosomatae tribe of the Asphodelaceae family. This plant is valued for its air-purifying properties and is believed to have various health benefits, such as reducing stress and anxiety, promoting better sleep, and boosting the immune system.
